g.text: Policy 'tenant_read' on public.documents contains a top-level `auth_func() IS NULL` disjunct in its USING claus
e. For anonymous connections that disjunct evaluates to true, satisfying the policy and exposing every row. Remove the I
S NULL disjunct or replace with an explicit deny.
The pattern: a policy with USING (auth_func() IS NULL OR <real check>).
auth_func() returns NULL for anonymous connections, so the IS NULL
disjunct is true and the OR is satisfied without ever evaluating the
real check. Anonymous clients see all rows.
-- [SEC001] Enable row-level security on public.audit_log. Add a policy afterward — a table with RLS enabled and no poli
cy denies all rows to non-owner roles.
ALTER TABLE public.audit_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
-- [SEC001] Enable row-level security on public.users. Add a policy afterward — a table with RLS enabled and no policy d
enies all rows to non-owner roles.
ALTER TABLE public.users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
pgrls: 2 fixes ready (dry-run). Re-run with --apply to execute.
